source_title: The Chronicles of Prydain: The Book of Three
continuity_scope: Exact authorized Macmillan/Henry Holt record for Lloyd Alexander, The Book of Three, The Chronicles of Prydain Volume 1, ISBN 9781429961943. This is an evidence-limited orientation pass, not a text-derived character catalogue: the publisher record supplies series and whole-book description but no controllable chapter/page witness for individual character claims. It excludes Disney's The Black Cauldron film, later Prydain books and short fiction, games, Welsh myth sources, and any claim transferred from them.

coverage_rule: No individual character records are included until authorized primary text, an authorized preview, or an official reference supplies claim-specific chapter/page or equivalent locators for this exact volume. Publisher whole-book copy and its named-character orientation are retained only as terms and are not expanded into character, relationship, age, gender, class, body/disability, violence, or power claims.
omissions: All individual dramatic characters, pending a usable authorized chapter/page witness for The Book of Three.
All character relationships, pending source-specific textual evidence.
Peoples/creatures, roles, magic, artifacts, places, institutions, and narrative motifs as character nodes.

content_cautions: The publisher record frames a young-reader fantasy quest and names a princess, bard, assistant pig-keeper, and companions, but this does not establish individual age, gender, class, disability/body, violence/death, agency, or relationship claims.

Alexander's author note explicitly distinguishes fictional Prydain from Wales and says it is not a retelling or retranslation of Welsh mythology. Welsh names or analogues therefore do not establish cultural equivalence or shared continuity.
No adaptation-derived characterization, event, violence, or ending information is used.
uncertainties: The authorized publisher page identifies the exact volume and includes a whole-book description and author note, but does not expose a stable chapter/page primary-text witness for granular claims.
This pass should be replaced or expanded only with an authorized edition or preview that provides precise textual locators.
evidence_basis: Macmillan's authorized book record and Lloyd Alexander author note establish the edition/series boundary and the Prydain-versus-Wales distinction. They are insufficient for a reliable detailed character pass, so this pass honestly has zero character and relationship records.
